policy.official_reference_use: A human-reviewed official link is usable within its recorded scope after checking publisher, source identity, language, displayed date/version or cutoff, relevant content, and visible limits. No local capture, conversion, hash, or replay is required for ordinary link use.
policy.local_artifact_acceptance: Ten accepted local public-text snapshots are recorded: eight Service Public/DILA guidance, procedure-directory and administration-directory records, one CNIL guidance text reproduction under CC BY-ND 4.0 FR, and one Conseil d’État court-source guide under its public-information reuse terms. fr-conseil-etat-450285-450288-2022.version_or_cutoff: Joined decision nos. 450285 and 450288, 24 February 2022; follow-up decision no. 450285, 2 February 2024, after CJEU judgment C-143/22.

The official 2024 follow-up (https://www.conseil-etat.fr/fr/arianeweb/CE/decision/2024-02-02/450285) followed CJEU judgment C-143/22 and partially annulled the second sentence of L. 332-3 insofar as it was not limited to readmission under a pre-13 January 2009 agreement or arrangement.
limitations: The original 2022 www.conseil-etat.fr URL returned 404; the official non-www ArianeWeb URL recorded here was opened successfully. The 2024 follow-up is separately linked in the reviewed-content note.
These decisions concern specific provisions of the 2020 CESEDA recodification. Check the current consolidated CESEDA and CJEU judgment C-143/22 for date-sensitive use.
